In Crazy Bird, you play the role of a bird that must navigate through a series of increasingly difficult levels, avoiding obstacles and enemies while collecting fruit to earn points. The game's core premise is simple yet effective: flip your bird up and down to avoid enemies, collect fruit to score, and don't hit enemies or spikes, or your score will take a hit.

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game's main objective is to navigate your bird through a series of increasingly difficult levels, collecting fruit to earn points while avoiding enemies and obstacles. The game's controls are simple yet effective, with players using their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to flip their bird up and down, dodging enemies and collecting fruit in the process.

One of the key mechanics that makes Crazy Bird so challenging is the game's use of physics-based gameplay. The bird's movement is smooth and realistic, with players needing to time their jumps and dodges perfectly to avoid enemies and obstacles. The game also features a variety of obstacles and enemies that players must avoid, including spikes, enemies that move up and down the screen, and enemies that fly across the screen.
